question: How do prefill and decode batch and execute under CUDA graphs in the measured stack; what does per-period wall time decompose into; and why do conveyor resume prefills vary between 54 and 69 tokens
configuration_profile: Offline analysis of the two retained N=8 runs (RUN-BASELINE-RETAINED, async scheduling; RUN-CONVEYOR-RETAINED, synchronous retained-prefix eviction) on RTX 3090 with Qwen2.5-Omni Thinker-only, plus a source audit of the pinned vllm==0.23.0 wheel; no new run
change: None; read-only analysis of retained artifacts (scheduler.log, per_iteration.log, worker.log) and pinned engine source
result: Decode steps run under FULL CUDA graphs at a 23.6-23.8 ms per-step floor consistent with reading the full bf16 weights each step, +0.66 ms per additional sequence. 200 of 202 (baseline) and 499 of 507 (conveyor) prefill-containing steps exceed the 32-token capture cap and run eager-compiled; a single 53-token audio chunk already exceeds the cap. Prefill steps carry roughly 18-20 ms fixed cost above the graphed decode floor and a +10.67 ms shape step above 64 total scheduled tokens (43% of conveyor resume steps cross it). Per period, the conveyor run decomposes to 1480 ms decode (62.1 steps) + 520 ms prefill (8 steps) + 0 ms idle; the baseline run to ~1024 ms active + ~970 ms idle. Conveyor resume prefill equals chunk + 1 + ((C-1) mod 16), matching 58 of 62 steady periods exactly; the discarded end-of-segment sampled token implies net context growth of 77 tokens per period versus the workload constant 78. Source audit also narrows the async-scheduling hazard: retained-prefix eviction runs on the scheduler thread, and the vLLM AsyncScheduler fences max-tokens stops, the only stop kind the measured path uses.
remaining_uncertainty: Baseline step timings are throughput-attributed under async scheduling and lower-bound true step latency
One retained run per system; both fail current formal acceptance (dirty manifests, no patch artifacts)
The async-scheduling fence coverage for the retained-prefix eviction path is a source-audit conclusion, not validated by a run
Correcting CONTEXT_GROWTH_TOKENS_PER_PERIOD from 78 to 77 is an experiment-protocol change pending its own transaction
Capture-list tuning, output-cap alignment to the KV block size, and async-scheduling restoration are unimplemented follow-ups; none may enter findings as performance status before a verifying run
